# server isn't running, or the address is wrong, or traffic is blocked

ERROR: couldn't reach cluster "local" at localhost:8443

  Nothing answered after 5s. The address resolved, so either the server isn't
  running or something between here and there is dropping the connection.

  Possible causes
    • the server isn't running
    • a firewall is blocking UDP port 8443
    • the cluster's address has changed

  Try
    miren doctor          check what's reachable
    miren cluster list    confirm the address

# connection established, then the server went quiet mid-request

ERROR: lost the connection to cluster "local" at localhost:8443

  Connected successfully, then it went quiet for 30s partway through the
  request. The server was reachable a moment earlier.

  Possible causes
    • the server crashed or restarted mid-request
    • the server is overloaded and stopped responding
    • the network path dropped

  Try
    miren doctor    check whether it's back

# request accepted, no reply before our deadline

ERROR: cluster "local" never answered

  Waited 8s after localhost:8443 accepted the request and nothing came back. The
  connection was still open when we gave up, so the request reached the server,
  but no reply followed.

  Possible causes
    • the server is still starting up
    • the server is wedged or overloaded
    • the server stopped responding after accepting the connection

  Try
    miren doctor     check whether it's still responding
    miren version    compare CLI and cluster versions

# cluster is healthy but doesn't offer the capability

ERROR: cluster "local" doesn't provide what "miren route list" needs

  The cluster answered, but it isn't currently offering "entities", which this
  command needs.

  Possible causes
    • the server is still starting up and hasn't registered it yet
    • the cluster is running an older miren than your CLI

  Try
    miren doctor     check whether the server is ready
    miren version    compare CLI and cluster versions

# not authorized

ERROR: access denied on cluster "local"

  You don't have permission to access this cluster. If you were signed in
  previously, your session may have expired.

  Try
    miren login     sign in again
    miren whoami    check your current identity

# unexpected HTTP status

ERROR: cluster "local" returned an unexpected response (HTTP 404)

  Asked localhost:8443 for "entities" and got HTTP 404 instead of a capability.
  That usually means the address points at something that isn't a miren server,
  or at a version that doesn't serve this endpoint.

  Try
    miren cluster list    confirm the address
    miren version         compare CLI and cluster versions

# response body wasn't what we expected

ERROR: couldn't understand the response from cluster "local"

  localhost:8443 answered the request but the response wasn't in the expected
  format. The address may point at something that isn't a miren server.

  Try
    miren cluster list    confirm the address

# with -v (underlying error preserved)

ERROR: couldn't reach cluster "local" at localhost:8443

  Nothing answered after 5s. The address resolved, so either the server isn't
  running or something between here and there is dropping the connection.

  Possible causes
    • the server isn't running
    • a firewall is blocking UDP port 8443
    • the cluster's address has changed

  Try
    miren doctor          check what's reachable
    miren cluster list    confirm the address

  Cause: no response from localhost:8443 after 5s while looking up "entities": timeout: no recent network activity
